name: P2a - Scheduled job that writes a heartbeat

nodes.name: Release due tasks and write heartbeat
nodes.notes: The heartbeat is written in the SAME statement as the work (a data-modifying CTE always runs to completion, even when the work returns 0 rows). Retry is safe: the update only moves due tasks to done and the beat is an upsert. Create the tables first: sql/p2-heartbeat-tables.sql.
